theme: Reinvest or cash out, ten thousand times
title: Reinvest or Cash Out, Ten Thousand Times
innovation_hook: Always reinvesting compounds best in an infinite horizon and loses in a finite one, where the endgame must switch to harvesting. The switch point depends on remaining turns AND on the next unlock threshold, not on a fixed ratio.
strategies: never-reinvest baseline: harvest every turn's output immediately, capital never grows, reproduces the evaluator's weak reference

best fixed reinvest fraction: grid-search a single constant reinvest ratio applied every turn, simulated on the visible instance and tuned per instance -- the natural first parameterization, but structurally cannot express a threshold-aware regime switch

best single switch point: search over every possible turn to flip from full-reinvest to full-harvest, using the exact thresholds/multipliers/turns-remaining to pick the switch that maximizes simulated final score -- front-loads compounding then converts before the endgame discount bites
multi-phase adaptive plan / local search around the single-switch solution: perturb reinvest/harvest phase boundaries (seeded, deterministic) to squeeze out remaining value near multiple thresholds
